description: Add, remove, enable, or disable a RouterOS logging rule. Idempotent by topics+logAction (add → already_exists on match; remove → not_found handled gracefully; enable/disable throw NOT_FOUND when absent). Supports dry-run.

logAction.description: Log action target name (RouterOS action field) — idempotency key

prefix.description: Optional prefix to prepend to log messages

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

topics.description: Log topics (e.g. firewall, system, info) — idempotency key

name: manage_log_rule
title: Manage Log Rule
